findings.evidence: release_policy.py:14; testable observation: the module never imports or calls hmac.compare_digest.
findings.summary: Digest equality uses != instead of hmac.compare_digest.

findings.evidence: release_policy.py:16-18; testable observation: root "services/api" authorizes "services/api-evil/config.py", and malformed paths or roots can pass.
findings.summary: Paths and roots are not validated, and raw prefix matching can authorize out-of-scope paths.

findings.evidence: release_policy.py:17-19; testable observation: a rename from "private/secret" into an allowed root passes, an unknown action passes, and a record without "path" raises KeyError.
findings.summary: Rename sources and actions are ignored; malformed records can also raise an exception instead of being denied.

findings.evidence: release_policy.py:16-19; testable observation: release_allowed("a", "a", [], []) returns True.
findings.summary: An empty root set is accepted when there are no changes.
